Hear directly from our NPTEL Stars of the South Zone as they share their experience, journey, and feedback captured during our event on July 10, 2026.
In this video, our top performers talk about how NPTEL courses helped them grow academically and professionally, the challenges they overcame, and their advice for future learners.
NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning) is a joint initiative by the IITs and IISc, offering free online courses across engineering, science, humanities, and management.
